- Utah Driver Handbook Section One: Definitions","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C - Utah Driver Handbook Section One: Definitions

FACT_ID: sec01-F01 | anchor: A01
An Alcohol Restricted Driver is anyone barred from driving with any alcohol in their body after an alcohol-related conviction, suspension, or revocation [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F02 | anchor: A01
Assumption of Financial Responsibility is a parent, guardian, or willing responsible adult of the applicant taking on the obligation [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F03 | anchor: A01
A bicycle is a human-powered wheeled vehicle driven by feet or hands on pedals or cranks, with a saddle for ground use and wheels at least 14 inches across, including electric-assisted bicycles [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F04 | anchor: A01
Blind spots are the roadway areas a driver cannot see in the mirrors while operating the vehicle [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F05 | anchor: A01
Cancellation ends a driver license issued through error or fraud, through an application for a state license or ID card, or after required consent is withdrawn [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F06 | anchor: A01
Careless driving means two or more moving violations in one continuous drive, or one moving violation while distracted by an unrelated in-vehicle activity such as searching for an item, attending to hygiene, or grooming [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F07 | anchor: A01
A Commercial Driver License covers vehicles rated 26,001 pounds GVWR or more, or built for 16 or more passengers, hazardous materials, doubles or triples, bulk-liquid tankers, or school buses [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F08 | anchor: A01
Denied means the driving privilege has been withdrawn [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F09 | anchor: A01
A dependent is a spouse and any unmarried children under age 21 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F10 | anchor: A01
Disqualification is the temporary or permanent withdrawal of a commercial driver license [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F11 | anchor: A01
The Division is the Driver License Division of the Department of Public Safety [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F12 | anchor: A01
A Driving Privilege Card evidences Utah driving privilege obtained without proof of lawful presence in the United States [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F13 | anchor: A01
Extreme DUI needs proof of .16-plus blood or breath alcohol, or .05-plus with any measurable controlled substance, or two or more combined controlled substances other than Cannabinoid Research, Medical Cannabis, or prescribed drugs [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F14 | anchor: A01
A farm tractor is any self-propelled vehicle designed and used mainly as a farm implement of husbandry [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F15 | anchor: A02
A head check is glancing over your shoulder toward your intended move to cover the blind spot [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F16 | anchor: A02
A highway is the full width between property lines of every way or place open as a matter of right to vehicle travel [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F17 | anchor: A02
An Ignition Interlock Device is a constant monitor requiring a breath alcohol sample to start and operate a vehicle [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F18 | anchor: A02
An interdicted person is anyone whom law or court order bars from receiving alcoholic products by sale, offer, or furnishing, including a person who of their own accord obtains a driver license or identification card [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F19 | anchor: A02
An Interlock Restricted Driver may not operate a vehicle lacking an installed ignition interlock system [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F20 | anchor: A02
A license is the privilege of driving a motor vehicle [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F21 | anchor: A02
A license certificate is the document evidencing the privilege to drive a motor vehicle [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F22 | anchor: A02
A Limited-Term Driver License evidences driving privilege for one who proved lawful presence but is not a U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, or Legal Permanent Resident Alien [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F23 | anchor: A02
A Limited-Term Identification Card goes to one who proved lawful presence but is not a U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, or Legal Permanent Resident Alien [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F24 | anchor: A02
A low-speed vehicle is a four-wheeled electric motor vehicle for speeds up to 25 miles per hour, seating at most four passengers including the driver; golf carts and off-highway vehicles are excluded [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F25 | anchor: A02
A mobility vehicle serves a person with a physical disability, meets Division specifications, and runs on public roadways within restrictions for holders of a valid mobility vehicle permit [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F26 | anchor: A02
A mobility vehicle permit is Division-issued authority setting the conditions for a person with a physical disability to drive a mobility vehicle on a public highway [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F27 | anchor: A02
A motor vehicle is any self-propelled vehicle except motorized wheelchairs, electric personal assistive mobility devices, and vehicles moved solely by human power [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F28 | anchor: A02
A motorcycle is a motor vehicle other than a farm tractor, with a rider saddle and at most three wheels touching the ground [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F29 | anchor: A02
A Non-Domiciled CDL evidences commercial driving privilege for one who proved lawful presence but is not a U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, or Legal Permanent Resident Alien [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F30 | anchor: A02
An operator is whoever holds actual physical control of a motor vehicle [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F31 | anchor: A03
A pedestrian vehicle is a self-propelled conveyance for persons with a physical disability, at most 48 inches wide, with an engine at or below 300 cubic centimeters or 12 brake horsepower, unable to exceed 30 miles per hour [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F32 | anchor: A03
A personal motorized mobility device is self-propelled on two non-tandem wheels, steers and stops under typical conditions, has a motor up to one horsepower or 750 watts, and a stand-on deck [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F33 | anchor: A03
A private passenger carrier is a hired motor vehicle built for 15 or fewer passengers including the driver, used to carry an employee of the hiring party [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F34 | anchor: A03
A provisional license is a Utah license for anyone under 21 years of age [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F35 | anchor: A03
A Regular CDL evidences commercial driving privilege for a U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, or Legal Permanent Resident Alien [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F36 | anchor: A03
A Regular Identification Card is issued to a U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, or Legal Permanent Resident Alien [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F37 | anchor: A03
A Regular License Certificate evidences driving privilege for a U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, or Legal Permanent Resident Alien [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F38 | anchor: A03
Revocation ends the privilege of driving a motor vehicle [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F39 | anchor: A03
A roundabout is a circular intersection with counterclockwise traffic flow [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F40 | anchor: A03
A school bus is a commercial motor vehicle carrying pre-primary, primary, or secondary students between home and school or to school-sponsored events [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F41 | anchor: A03
A street-legal all-terrain vehicle is an all-terrain type I or utility-type vehicle modified for highway operation [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F42 | anchor: A03
Suspension is the temporary withdrawal of driving privilege [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F43 | anchor: A03
A taxicab is a Class D motor vehicle carrying any number of riders for hire under state or federal taxi rules [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F44 | anchor: A03
A temporary driver license allows driving up to six months and is unavailable to Driving Privilege Card (DPC) holders [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F45 | anchor: A03
A traffic check is a defensive scan for nearby traffic, pedestrians, and other obstacles met while driving [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F46 | anchor: A03
A vehicle is any device carrying people or property on a highway, except devices used only on fixed rails or tracks [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0013]
